summary: Tested 4 major changes shipped this session: Custom Documents (templates/submissions/fuel-analytics), Staff invitation+activation tokens, Legal records API+UI, Tenant user create returning email_sent. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend: All 7 public legal pages load OK, landing footer has 7 legal links + QuickFleet copyright, /activate?token=bogus shows 'Link not valid' error state. CRITICAL frontend bug found: PlatformAdmin Legal tab throws uncaught ReferenceError because LegalRecordsSection component is used but never imported in PlatformAdmin.js.

The whole Legal admin UI is unreachable in the browser even though the underlying GET/PUT /api/platform/legal-records APIs work correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: PlatformAdmin.js uses <LegalRecordsSection /> at line ~3520 but never imports it — runtime crash on Legal tab. This is a missed import after extracting the component.
Legal-records GET response correctly strips _id and metadata fields; PUT upserts correctly.

documents service correctly coerces number strings to float, extracts vehicle_id+vehicle_registration from the data dict, and validates required fields server-side returning 400 with the human field label (e.g. "'Date' is required").
activation_tokens collection in Mongo stores token, user_id, user_email, tenant_id, used (bool), expires_at — schema is clean; second-use after activation correctly rejected.
Resend DKIM failure path returns email_sent=false with email_error from Resend in the user-create response — non-fatal, as designed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 major shipped features are functionally correct on the backend (12/12 pytest tests pass against the preview env). Public legal pages + activate-link error state are good in browser. The single blocker for end-to-end browser validation of (1) the Legal admin tab and (2) the Documents tenant UI is that PlatformAdmin.js is missing `import LegalRecordsSection from '../components/LegalRecordsSection'` — this throws an uncaught ReferenceError as soon as a super_admin clicks the Legal tab. Fix that one line and rerun the pytest file plus a quick UI smoke of the Documents sub-tab and mobile staff Docs tab.
rca_of_legal_tab_bug: PlatformAdmin.js references <LegalRecordsSection ... /> at line 3520 but never imports the component. The component file exists at /app/frontend/src/components/LegalRecordsSection.js. React renders the page fine until the user clicks the Legal tab, at which point JSX evaluation hits the undefined identifier and throws ReferenceError, surfaced by the dev overlay as 'LegalRecordsSection is not defined'. Fix: add the missing import statement at the top of PlatformAdmin.js.
